explanation: This function is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format() embeds poll_name directly inside single quotes in the SELECT query passed to queryOne(). Crafted input in poll_name could break out of the literal and alter the query to extract unauthorized database records. The repair binds poll_name with a '?' placeholder and (poll_name,), though the table name from CFG() remains string-formatted into SQL and the custom queryOne helper is not shown.
